description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Terms and conditions for filling or developing a portion of land under Land Reclamation & Development Corporation Act
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily deals with land-related matters. It declares specific areas in the Polonnaruwa District as "low lands, marshes, barren or muddy lands" under the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation Act. The content focuses on land classification, development regulations, and terms/conditions for land reclamation activities. While it mentions a minister (Patali Champika Ranawaka), it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, and the core subject matter is land administration rather than government personnel or structure.
